title: Claude Code: Remote Control
summary: Remote Control connects claude.ai/code or the Claude app to a session running on your machine; the machine keeps the files, MCP servers and tools, and the conversation stays in sync across devices. claude remote-control runs a server that creates sessions on demand (--spawn same-dir or worktree, up to 32 by default). A cloud session can ask to use a folder on the user's computer. Trusted Devices can be required. A mod's drawing shows only in the terminal on that machine, not on the phone.
ideas: avenMAIA could run locally, with its mod, and still be reachable from the phone.
Remote Control is what lets a local session list and message cloud sessions.

took.idea: A local avenMAIA reachable from the phone
